title: Fiber Fingerprints of Hidden Learning-State Dynamics
abstract: arXiv:2608.15976v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A learning system can occupy execution states that are indistinguishable under every declared present-behavior readout yet respond differently to future training. We formalize this through fiber fingerprints: controlled future-learning response laws restricted to present-behavior equivalence classes. Prefix-compatible finite probes induce a predictive quotient functor, a Nerode-type minimal recursively sufficient representation, and a canonical set-level predictive fiber without assuming smoothness, reversibility, finite rank, or a manifold. Under an explicit finite-dimensional Hilbert realization, response decomposes into visible, visible-mode-reuse, and irreducible-new sectors; a history-reachability bridge retains only distinctions generated by natural training histories. translated_title: 隐藏学习状态动力学的纤维指纹
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.15976v1 公告类型：新 摘要：一个学习系统可以占据执行状态，这些状态在所有声明的当前行为读出下无法区分，但对未来训练却有不同的响应。我们通过纤维指纹来形式化这一概念：受限于当前行为等价类的受控未来学习响应法则。前缀兼容的有限探针诱导出一个预测商函子、一个Nerode型最小递归充分表示，以及一个规范的集合级预测纤维，而无需假设光滑性、可逆性、有限秩或流形结构。在显式有限维希尔伯特实现下，响应分解为可见、可见模式重用和不可约新三个部分；历史可达性桥仅保留自然训练历史所产生的区分。条件机制结果随后识别出图-霍奇时间顺序分解、一个正则切换类，其均方根尺度为$\sqrt{p}\eta^{3/2}$，以及有限性。
tldr: 本文通过“纤维指纹”概念形式化了学习系统中状态在行为上不可区分但未来学习响应不同的现象，并提供了无需平滑性或流形假设的通用表示与分解方法。
en_tdlr: This paper formalizes the phenomenon of learning states that are behaviorally indistinguishable yet differ in future learning responses via "fiber fingerprints," offering a general representation and decomposition framework without smoothness or manifold assumptions.
